title: The Maharashtra Self-financed Schools (Establishment and Regulation) Act, 2012
full_text: The Maharashtra Self-financed Schools (Establishment and Regulation) Act, 2012 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20131 Act Number: 1 Enactment Date: 2013-01-04 Act Year: 2013 Short Title: The Maharashtra Self-financed Schools (Establishment and Regulation) Act, 2012 Long Title: An Act to make provisions to establish a new school including provision for up gradation of existing school on self-financed basis, to make suitable provisions with regard to requirements and norms for establishing such new school or up-gradation of existing school, for creating an endowment fund and to provide for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Provisions of Act to apply to school seeking affiliation to any Board or institution in the State, outside State or outside India. Section 16. Protection of action taken in good faith. Section 20. Officers, etc., to be public servants. Section 21. Act shall be in addition to existing laws. Section 22. Delegation of powers. Section 23. Power to make rules. Section 24. Power to remove difficulties.
